QuestInfo.name: By Land, Sea, and Air
QuestInfo.0: Piston wants to talk to you.
QuestInfo.1:
Those that contribute to the successful prevention of Dimension Invasions will receive Medals.

#rTip: Complete Dimension Invasion Hidden Stage Hilla, Hilla vs Magnus, and Magnus Battle to complete the quest.

0.0: This battle transcends dimensions. No one knows the outcome, but at least you can get a good looking Medal from me if you make it out alive.

yes.0: Experience is the most important key to a successful warrior.

no.0: Strength is important, but so is experience.

1.0: You seem to have gained a lot of experience from Dimension Invasion. You deserve this medal.

default.0: Experience is crucial. Why don't you enter Dimensional Invasion and work on yours?
